prompt: Read the JSON list of Gmail message IDs in /app/svb_ids_0.json (mailbox robert@harmonygames.co; use user_email "me"). For EVERY id, fetch it with mcp__hg__gmail_get_message (format "full") and base64url-decode payload.body.data (or parts) to get the plain text of the SVB notification. Extract: subject, notice type (e.g. Payment Processed / Returned / Cancelled / Approval etc.), From account, To (payee name as written and account last 4), Amount (number) and currency, Transaction Date, Delivery Date, Transaction ID, any other notable text (e.g. return reason). Write one JSON object per line to /app/svb_part_0.jsonl with keys: id, subject, type, from_acct, payee, payee_acct, amount, currency, txn_date, delivery_date, txn_id, extra. Do not skip any id; if a fetch fails, retry, and record errors with an "error" key. You may fetch several messages in parallel per turn. When done, reply only with the count of lines written and any ids that failed.
